title: Molecular Properties of Matter
notes: **Matter is particulate:** all matter is made of tiny particles (atoms or molecules) in constant random motion.
**Intermolecular spaces:** the space between molecules is much larger than the molecules themselves in gases, smaller in liquids, and smallest in solids.
**Intermolecular forces:** attractive forces between molecules. They are strongest in solids, weaker in liquids, and negligible in gases at ordinary conditions.
**Kinetic energy vs potential energy:** in gases, kinetic energy dominates; in solids, potential energy dominates because molecules are held in fixed positions by strong intermolecular forces.
